pad_2d_mask: pad a list of int lists to a 2D tensor and return a mask tensor for non-pad positions
truncate_tokens: truncate a batch of token lists to a maximum sequence length with a pad token
make_byte_inputs: convert a batch of token strings into a 3D byte tensor with sequence lengths
add_bos_eos_2d: add beginning and end of sequence tokens to each sequence in a 2D int list
utf8_chars: split a UTF-8 encoded string into a list of individual character strings
